root.label: Borrowed ranges and dangling
root.note: Iterators are valid only while their elements' owner lives; borrowed ranges do not own them.

children.label: borrowed_range
children.note: Iterators obtained from the object stay valid after the object is destroyed.

children.label: Lvalue references
children.note: Always borrowed: the caller keeps owning the object.

children.label: enable_borrowed_range
children.note: Opt-in variable template, false by default and never checked.

children.label: Owning is not borrowed
children.note: owning_view of a vector owns its elements, so it is not borrowed.

children.label: ranges::dangling
children.note: Returned instead of an iterator when the range is a non-borrowed rvalue.

children.label: borrowed_iterator_t
children.note: iterator_t<R> if R is borrowed, otherwise ranges::dangling.

children.label: Fails on use
children.note: dangling has no operator* or ++, so using it is a compile error.

children.label: Values are safe
children.note: ranges::min returns a copy, so it works on temporaries.

children.label: Legacy std:: unprotected
children.note: std::find on a temporary's iterators compiles and dangles.

children.label: Standard borrowed types
children.note: Types whose iterators reach elements owned elsewhere or carry their own state.

children.label: Always borrowed
children.note: string_view, span, subrange, ref_view, empty_view and iota_view.

children.label: Conditionally borrowed
children.note: take, drop, drop_while, common, reverse, elements: if the base view is.

children.label: Never borrowed
children.note: transform_view and filter_view iterators point back into the view.

children.label: Pipelines and temporaries
children.note: Ownership follows how views::all sees the argument.

children.label: Rvalue container
children.note: Moved into owning_view since P2415, so the pipeline is safe.

children.label: Member of a temporary
children.note: Seen as an lvalue, wrapped in ref_view, and dead at the semicolon.

children.label: string_view of a temporary
children.note: Borrowed from a string that is destroyed immediately.

children.label: Range-based for
children.note: The initializer is bound to auto&& __range for the whole loop.

children.label: Before C++23
children.note: Only the temporary bound directly is extended; make().items() dangles.

children.label: C++23 P2718
children.note: All temporaries in the for-range-initializer live until the loop ends.

children.label: Loop only
children.note: auto& r = make().items(); still dangles in every version.

children.label: Returning views
children.note: A view must not outlive what it refers to, including captures.

children.label: View of a local
children.note: Returns a ref_view to a destroyed vector; compilers rarely warn.

children.label: Move the container in
children.note: return std::move(v) | adaptor gives an owning_view.

children.label: Lambda captures
children.note: Capturing locals by reference in a stored lambda dangles on return.
